title: Metals and metalloids in macrophytes and fish from an acid mine drainage-impacted river system in South Africa: aspects of bioindication and phytoremediation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, 4,1501-1513
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00136F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jakob Windisch, Andreas Gradwohl, Beric Michael Gilbert, Quinton Marco Dos Santos, Annemariè Avenant-Oldewage, Franz Jirsa
The consequences of acid mine drainage (AMD) are apparent in water and sediment of the upper reaches of the Crocodile River (West) system, which is located in the western basin of the Witwatersrand mountain chain in South Africa.
